# Package <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#package-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">Package</span></span><a href="#syside.Package" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`Package`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> A <span class="pre">`Package`</span> is a <span class="pre">`Namespace`</span> used to group <span class="pre">`Elements`</span>, without any instance-level semantics. It may have one or more model-level evaluable <span class="pre">`filter_condition`</span> <span class="pre">`Expressions`</span> used to filter its <span class="pre">`imported_memberships`</span>. Any imported <span class="pre">`member`</span> must meet all of the <span class="pre">`filter_conditions`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=97" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.4.14</a> of the KerML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=264" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.4.13.4</a> of the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> The model-level evaluable <span class="pre">`Boolean`</span>-valued <span class="pre">`Expression`</span> used to filter the <span class="pre">`members`</span> of this <span class="pre">`Package`</span>, which are owned by the <span class="pre">`Package`</span> are via <span class="pre">`ElementFilterMemberships`</span>.
>
